notes.title: Our Gameplay Trailer is Live!
notes.notes:
We have released the gameplay trailer of our game that will be released today!

You can watch it on our Youtube and Steam page. In the video where we try to explain the structure of the game simply; we've added details from the beginning of a game, to the management of the port, to the puzzle scene. If you like the video, we invite you to the game's release with Puzzle Festival. You can take advantage of the special discount and buy and experience the game.

[previewyoutube=enJoMo8ZNrw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: We Are In The Puzzle Festival!
notes.notes:
We have good news for you. We will publish our game together with the Puzzle Festival that will be held by Steam. Check out and there will be discounts with the festival!

Stay tuned to have our game with this beautiful event. You can also add a Wishlist so you don't miss the 1-week sale. We are planning to share with you the full version of our game and many new features to be added to it this week. Therefore, you can also follow our newsletter and social media accounts.

In this game where we blend Chess and Puzzle, you get a little closer to retirement every day you can survive and stand up to your evil boss. You are also invited to the Festival and our game to step into this difficult struggle.

See you at the event! ^-^

notes.title: Wishlist D.C.K. Now!
notes.notes:
[b]We Completed Our Game's Steam Page![/b]

We wanted to announce this happiness to you as well. You can visit our game's steam page. Don't forget to follow Valentware Games social media to learn more about our game, which we will release very soon.

Do you want to play puzzle mechanics with chess logic? That's the feel we were aiming for in this game. We established the system by choosing chess pieces and correct points. This game, where you have to fight to protect your job under a cruel boss, will be released coming soon!
